title: Maximum Sum Obtained of Any Permutation
description: Maximize the sum of range queries by rearranging array elements using a frequency map of indices.
pseudocode:
1. count = new Array(n).fill(0)
2. for [start, end] in requests: count[start]++, count[end+1]--
3. for i from 1 to n: count[i] += count[i-1]
4. nums.sort((a,b) => a - b)
5. count.sort((a,b) => a - b)
6. total = 0
7. for i from 0 to n-1: total += nums[i] * count[i]
8. return total

steps.note: Initialize frequency array of size 5 with zeros
Apply difference array for requests [1, 3] and [0, 2]
Compute prefix sums to get actual frequencies
